Description

This Dragon line turns temporary combat buffs into permanent keywords and stats. Crimson VindicatorTier 6 casts Mighty Dragonbreath through Rally, Sky-hatch RunawayTier 4 triggers that Rally during recruit, and Fire-forged EvokerTier 6 improves its start-of-combat Dragon buff as Tavern spells are cast.

The combat conversion comes from Persistent PoetTier 4. Put WarpwingTier 6 beside it so combat-granted stats, Divine Shield, Windfury, and other bonus keywords persist. Warpwing is then a premium recipient: immunity while attacking lets retained attack and Windfury translate into repeated safe hits.

When to commit

The source does not force Dragons from the opening. It stabilizes with an early Dragon shell, then commits after finding Warpwing and a way to trigger Crimson Vindicator while Tavern-spell casting has already improved Fire-forged Evoker. A lone Warpwing or Poet is useful tempo, but the real line needs both a repeatable buff source and Poet adjacency.

Enablers

  • Maldraxxus DaggerTrinket repeatedly creates extra Dark-Gifted copies of a chosen warband minion; the source uses those extra copies to deepen the Dragon package.
  • Azeroth Model GlobeTrinket supplies Tier 6 discoveries and Gold, helping reach Vindicator and additional Warpwing copies.
  • Tavern spells are not filler: every cast permanently improves Fire-forged Evoker's future start-of-combat buff.

How to play

  1. Use a reasonable early board instead of buying weak Dragons merely for the tribe label.
  2. Accumulate Tavern-spell casts so Fire-forged Evoker's combat buff becomes worth preserving.
  3. Use Sky-hatch Runaway on Crimson Vindicator to cast another Mighty Dragonbreath during recruit.
  4. Place Warpwing adjacent to Persistent Poet so combat-granted stats and bonus keywords become permanent.
  5. Add or copy further Warpwings only when Poet coverage and board space remain functional.

Positioning

Poet adjacency decides which Dragons keep combat gains. Lead with one Vindicator so Mighty Dragonbreath resolves before the immune Warpwings attack, then keep pure support pieces behind the carry package. Poet coverage can shift after an older Dragon has already retained its important keywords.

Failure modes

  • Missing Poet adjacency means the combat buffs and keywords disappear after the fight.
  • Triggering Vindicator before Fire-forged Evoker has meaningful spell-fed scaling produces a much smaller payoff.
  • Too many Poets or setup pieces can leave too few actual attackers; the source sells a Vindicator once the board needs more Warpwing pressure.
  • Tripling Warpwing is not automatic. The source declines a triple when separate immune attackers and separate retained buffs are stronger.
  • Permanent Divine Shield and large stats still need attack order discipline; a huge protected carry placed too early can waste its value.

Demonstrated payoff

The final Turn 14 recruit board shows two leading permanent Dragons above 11k Attack and another near 5k before combat. The following fight is explicitly marked as the final combat and ends in first place.

Useful timestamps

  • 6:35 — Warpwing appears and the game pivots away from the abandoned Pirate idea.
  • 10:15 — Vindicator and the Poet retention plan begin converting the accumulated spell scaling.
  • 12:25 — Double-Poet positioning and attack-order decisions become the main constraint.
  • 15:30 — The source restructures around the retained Warpwing buffs rather than preserving every Vindicator.
  • 18:32 — Final positioning before the first-place combat.
